title: Returns
subtitle: Requests from customers to send items back.
emptyBody: When a customer asks to send something back, the request lands here. Approve it, mark the goods received, and the refund is issued automatically — less your restocking fee.

statusActions.effectRefund: A refund is issued to the customer, less your restocking fee.
statusActions.effectBalance: Your shop balance is debited by the refunded amount.
statusActions.effectRestock: Lines marked for restock go back into inventory.
